installation.description: Permissions this actor may grant at the installation resource.
installation.title: Installation

csrf_token.description: Present only for an authenticated browser cookie session.
csrf_token.title: Csrf Token

cover_in_header.description: The first page is a cover sheet whose notice goes in the header notice printed on every page instead, so that page is not sent. Needs a header notice for your organization or the mailbox; a recipient that needs a cover sheet still gets it.
cover_in_header.title: Cover In Header

labels.description: Labels for this fax from your organization's list, such as legal; repeat the field.
labels.title: Labels

mailbox.description: The mailbox this fax is sent from, so its sending rules apply. You must work in that mailbox.
mailbox.title: Mailbox

patient_birth_date.description: The patient's birth date, such as 1980-04-30, for a recipient that confirms the patient.
patient_birth_date.title: Patient Birth Date

patient_family_name.description: The patient's family name, for a recipient that confirms the patient.
patient_family_name.title: Patient Family Name

patient_given_name.description: The patient's given name, for a recipient that confirms the patient.
patient_given_name.title: Patient Given Name

patient_record_number.description: Only for a recipient that takes documents into its health records (FHIR): the patient's medical record number there.
patient_record_number.title: Patient Record Number

patient_record_system.description: The system that medical record number belongs to, as a web address or OID; the FHIR client's own is used when left out.
patient_record_system.title: Patient Record System

send_by.description: The time this fax must be sent by: a date and time with an offset (2026-10-08T17:00-04:00), a date and time in the installation's time zone (2026-10-08 17:00), or a time (17:00, its next occurrence). Faxbot never holds the fax past it for the recipient's hours or a busy hour.
send_by.title: Send By

send_by_call.description: Place a real call through your fax provider or carrier even when the number is one of this installation's own numbers, instead of delivering it inside Faxbot. Test faxes use this.
send_by_call.title: Send By Call

send_now.description: Send at once even when this number sends faxes together; faxes waiting for it go in the same call.
send_now.title: Send Now

urgent.description: Send before other faxes waiting for the same number or line, and without waiting to go together with other faxes.
urgent.title: Urgent

workflow.description: The workflow this fax is part of, from your organization's sending rules.
workflow.title: Workflow

FSOutboundResultIn.description:
The channel variables mod_spandsp sets after txfax (``phase_e_handler`` in
src/mod/applications/mod_spandsp/mod_spandsp_fax.c, github.com/signalwire/freeswitch, read 2026-10-08):
``fax_success`` "1" or "0", ``fax_result_code`` (spandsp's T.30 completion code), ``fax_result_text``,
``fax_document_transferred_pages`` (spandsp's ``pages_tx`` when sending: pages the receiving machine
confirmed) and ``fax_document_total_pages`` (pages in the file).
FSOutboundResultIn.title: FSOutboundResultIn

UpdatePluginConfigIn.description: Submit only changed provider fields and the loaded expected_revision_id. An empty object submits no field edits.
UpdatePluginConfigIn.title: UpdatePluginConfigIn

UpdateSettingsRequest.description: Submit only changed fields and the loaded expected_revision_id. An empty object submits no field edits.
UpdateSettingsRequest.title: UpdateSettingsRequest

info.description: A proprietary, self-hosted fax API. Send faxes with a single function call. Use requires written permission from the owner.
info.title: Faxbot API

post.description: Deprecated: FreeSWITCH is removed in the next release.
A fax the engine received: the same hand-over as Asterisk's, for images in the engine's out folder only.

Another machine collected, or tried to collect, a fax Faxbot holds for it (hylafax/bin/polled): one
collection row on the held fax, once per report.
A call the engine answered that left no fax (hylafax/bin/sessions): its record and sentence.

The engine started (again). Every fax it took earlier and never reported on waits for a person
(uncertain): its call may have reached the other machine, and it is never sent again by itself.
A result that arrives later still replaces that with the real outcome.
